## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON with clear cyclical leadership; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Materials/Energy/Industrials leading while Tech is mixed, Leadership: Narrow (concentration in Materials & Technology), Style: Value/Cyclical favored.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +20.37%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +25.87%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +11.59%). Energy and Industrials follow: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.69% | 1M: +4.00%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weak: PEP BELOW TREND (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -4.49%), MO BELOW TREND (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -3.72%). Communication Services and parts of Technology are lagging: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.72% | 1M: -12.18%) and AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.53%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.53% | 1M: +9.86%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +20.37%), TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +6.65%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +11.59%). Leadership: Narrow (Materials & Technology concentration: 3/5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: PEP BELOW TREND (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -4.49%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.72% | 1M: -12.18%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -11.30%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -4.00% | 1M: -2.39%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.53%) — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech and select staples; reduce exposure to these laggards.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: SLB (1W: +15.12%), AMAT (1W: +12.53%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +9.16% | 1M: -1.14%), TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +6.65%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +25.87%). Major divergence: NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +2.10%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +0.25% | 1M: -0.97%), META RECOVERY (1W: +0.29% | 1M: -0.06%) — watch for trend break rather than enlarging core positions.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed with internal rotation; AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.53% | 1M: +9.86%) and TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +6.65%) lead while AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.53%) and MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -0.48%) lag, NVDA in CORRECTION (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +2.10%). Sector 1W: +0.60% | 1M: -0.69% (19 stocks) — internal rotation, selective exposure preferred.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive with broad participation; JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +6.33%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +9.31%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +7.01%) — sector acting as cyclicals’ ballast. Financial breadth supporting RISK-ON.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed but resilient: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +5.35%), JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -1.33% | 1M: +1.14%), LLY CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +4.88%), PFE RECOVERY (1W: +1.72% | 1M: -1.05%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Materials, Energy and select Financials (e.g., SLB ABOVE TREND, JPM ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to stretched Tech laggards (AAPL BELOW TREND, NOW BELOW TREND) and weak Consumer Staples. Style: Value/Cyclical favored while monitoring Big Tech divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.53% | 1M: +9.86%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +25.87%). BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.53%), TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.80% | 1M: -4.75%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.72% | 1M: -12.18%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +11.09%), Energy (1W: +5.20% | 1M: +2.10%), Industrials (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +7.59%). BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.48%) and Communication (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -0.13%) — monitor defensive flows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +2.10%) — watch 1M support for confirmation of resumed uptrend. AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.53%) — failure to reclaim near-term resistance signals further downside risk. JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +6.33%) — sustained break above recent highs would confirm Financial leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
MO (+80): FDA approval headline; MO BELOW TREND (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -3.72%) — bullish news but price is falling, divergence to monitor. MSFT (+50): AI thesis headline; MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -0.48%) — positive sentiment but price not yet confirming. LLY (+50): obesity research deal; LLY CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +4.88%) — sentiment aligns with 1M strength, watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AIG (-70): CEO surprise step-down; AIG CORRECTION (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +1.55%) — bearish news confirming sharp near-term weakness. PFE (-50): patent litigation headline; PFE RECOVERY (1W: +1.72% | 1M: -1.05%) — negative sentiment diverges from short-term price uptick and merits monitoring.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Value/Cyclical style bias. SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +20.37%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +6.33%) showing relative strength. Key risk is Big Tech divergence—NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +2.10%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +0.25% | 1M: -0.97%), META RECOVERY (1W: +0.29% | 1M: -0.06%)—watch for trend break and monitor AIG headline risk.
